why: Settled (Readings): an unrelated key that reads common.x must not change what common.a resolves to — same fallback as 009 (L1045-1049). In typesafe/config 1.4.9 this input fails (UnresolvedSubstitution) while the same input with the observer key named o24bbd resolves to 0: key order decides the result. That is a bug; lightbend/config#863 makes every order give a = 0, as here.
